answer_1.quote: We embedded our annotation approach as predictive models in a writing support system and evaluated it with 58 students in a controlled peer learning scenario.
answer_1.outputs: The system provides feedback on cognitive and emotional empathy levels in student peer reviews.

answer_2.quote: The model performances were measured in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score.

answer_4.quote: We received 58 valid results (mean age = 23.89, SD= 3.07, 30 were male, 28 female). The participants were told to read an essay about a business model of a peer student. Afterwards, they were asked to write a business model review for the peer...
answer_4.guideline: After the treatment, we measured the intention to use (ITU) by asking three items. We also asked the participants to judge their perceived empathy skill learning (PESL) by asking two items that covered cognitive and emotional empathy skills. Finally, we surveyed the perceived feedback accuracy (PFA) to control the accuracy of our model. All constructs were measured with a 1-to-7 point Likert scale (1: totally disagree to 7: totally agree, with 4 being a neutral statement).
